# image-to-text

Imported as `@elffuss/ai/image-to-text`, `@elffuss/ai/image-to-text/sizes`.

## `sdk/image-to-text/impl.js`

The image-to-text task where the model runs (a Worker, or the page with worker: false): Florence-2 base (fine-tuned, MIT) through Transformers.js, loaded by class (it is not a pipeline there) and fed only by the model store at the pinned commit (ctx.modelFetch()). Two of its prompts: a detailed caption, and the visible text with one region per line (so the lines come apart instead of running together, as the plain OCR prompt writes them).

### `run(state, input, opts = {}, ctx)`

`opts.want`: 'all' (default: caption and text), 'caption' or 'text'.
Resolves to { value: { caption, text, lines, width, height, device, dtype } }, as every task's run does.

## `sdk/image-to-text/index.js`

What a picture shows, in words, in the browser: a detailed caption and its visible text, with Florence-2 base (fine-tuned; Microsoft, MIT) on WebGPU or WebAssembly. The model comes from its ONNX repository at the pinned revision, through the Elffuss model store. The words are English: an assistant reads them and answers in the user's language.

### `class ImageToText`

Describe a picture. Runs in a Worker; the first `load()` or `run()` asks the model store for the files of the
variant this browser can run (WebGPU with shader-f16: fp16 vision and embeddings with a q4 encoder and decoder;
WebGPU without it: q4; WebAssembly: q8) and checks their hashes.

```js
import { ImageToText } from '@elffuss/ai/image-to-text';

const eyes = new ImageToText({ onProgress: p => console.log(p.status) });
const { caption, text, lines } = await eyes.run(file);              // { want: 'caption' | 'text' | 'all' }
await eyes.dispose();
```

`run(input, { want, signal })` takes a `Blob` or `File`, an `ImageBitmap` or an `ImageData`, and resolves to
`{ caption, text, lines, width, height, device, dtype }`: `caption` a few sentences, `lines` the lines of visible
text (none when there is no text), `text` those lines joined with « · ».

- `.constructor(options)`
- `.estimate(opts = {}, device = 'auto')`: Before anything is downloaded: can this browser run it, and how much it downloads. `missingBytes` is what the store still lacks (the whole download without a store to ask).

### `estimate({ store, registry, model } = {}, device = 'auto')`

See `ImageToText.estimate`.

### `describeImage`

Load, run once and dispose: `await describeImage(file, { want: 'text' })`.
